files/postgres/pg_hba.conf:
# "local" is for Unix domain socket connections only
local   cd4pe           query                                   reject
local   query           cd4pe                                   reject
local   all             all                                     trust
host    cd4pe           query           all                     reject
host    query           cd4pe           all                     reject
host    cd4pe           cd4pe           all                     scram-sha-256
host    query           query           all                     scram-sha-256
host    all             all             all                     reject
templates/cd4pe_env.epp:
CD4PE_BACKEND_SERVICE_ENDPOINT=http://@@HOSTNAME@@:8000
CD4PE_WEB_UI_ENDPOINT=https://@@HOSTNAME@@
JVM_ARGS=@@JVM_ARGS@@
LOG4J_PATH=/opt/pfi/log4j2.properties
CD4PE_VERSION=@@VERSION@@



# The following env-vars are to be removed over time as we modify the product
# for the new installer, or re-evaluated for even being needed
CD4PE_STAGE=beta
CD4PE_STORAGE_PROVIDER=DISK
CD4PE_STORAGE_BUCKET=cd4pe
CD4PE_ROUTE_PREFIX=/cd4pe
CD4PE_SECURE_COOKIE=false
CD4PE_EULA_ACCEPTED=true
OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=none
OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=none
OTEL_EXPORTER_JAEGER_ENDPOINT=http://jaeger-aio:14250
OTEL_EXPORTER_JAEGER_SERVICE_NAME=cd4pe
OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=service.name=cd4pe,service.version=dev
CD4PE_QUERY_SERVICE_TOKEN_PATH=/etc/puppetlabs/cd4pe/query-service/cd4pe-query-service-token
templates/log4j2.properties.epp:
status = error
dest = err
name = PropertiesConfig
monitorInterval = 60

appender.rolling.type = RollingFile
appender.rolling.name = RollingFile
appender.rolling.layout.type = PatternLayout
appender.rolling.layout.pattern = %d{yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.S z}:[%p]:[%t]:%c:%m%n
appender.rolling.fileName = /app/logs/application.log
appender.rolling.filePattern = /app/logs/application.%i.log.gz
appender.rolling.policies.type = Policies
appender.rolling.policies.size.type = SizeBasedTriggeringPolicy
appender.rolling.policies.size.size = 200MB
appender.rolling.strategy.type = DefaultRolloverStrategy
appender.rolling.strategy.max = 5

appender.access.type = RollingFile
appender.access.name = RollingAccess
appender.access.layout.type = PatternLayout
appender.access.layout.pattern = %m%n
appender.access.fileName = /app/logs/access.log
appender.access.filePattern = /app/logs/access.%i.log.gz
appender.access.policies.type = Policies
appender.access.policies.size.type = SizeBasedTriggeringPolicy
appender.access.policies.size.size = 200MB
appender.access.strategy.type = DefaultRolloverStrategy
appender.access.strategy.max = 5

rootLogger.level = info
rootLogger.appenderRef.rolling.ref = RollingFile

logger.apache.name = org.apache
logger.apache.level = warn
logger.apache.additivity = false
logger.apache.appenderRef.console.ref = RollingFile

logger.jetty.name = org.eclipse.jetty
logger.jetty.level = info
logger.jetty.additivity = false
logger.jetty.appenderRef.console.ref = RollingFile

logger.hibernate.name = org.hibernate
logger.hibernate.level = info
logger.hibernate.additivity = false
logger.hibernate.appenderRef.console.ref = RollingFile

logger.jerseyApi.name = com.puppet.cdpe.web.api.accesslog
logger.jerseyApi.level = info
logger.jerseyApi.additivity = false
logger.jerseyApi.appenderRef.console.ref = RollingAccess

logger.distelliApi.name = com.distelli.webserver.WebServlet
logger.distelliApi.level = info
logger.distelliApi.additivity = false
logger.distelliApi.appenderRef.console.ref = RollingAccess
templates/postgres/postgresql.conf.epp:
listen_addresses = '*'
wal_level = 'hot_standby'
max_wal_senders = '16'
wal_keep_size = '12'
client_min_messages = 'error'
password_encryption = scram-sha-256             # md5 or scram-sha-256
shared_buffers = 128MB                  # min 128kB
max_wal_size = 1GB
min_wal_size = 80MB
timezone = 'Etc/UTC'
lc_messages = 'en_US.utf8'                      # locale for system error message
lc_monetary = 'en_US.utf8'                      # locale for monetary formatting
lc_numeric = 'en_US.utf8'                       # locale for number formatting
lc_time = 'en_US.utf8'                          # locale for time formatting
default_text_search_config = 'pg_catalog.english'
shared_preload_libraries = 'pgaudit'

# logging
log_min_error_statement=ERROR
log_destination=stderr
logging_collector=on
log_directory='/var/log/postgresql'
log_filename='postgresql.log'
log_timezone = 'Etc/UTC'
